footerReviewHelpers.purpose: Resolve tiny footer-digit review uncertainty without inventing pixels; original whole JPEGs were independently viewed first.
footerReviewHelpers.method: Each original footer rectangle (1150,695,1280,720), 6× nearest-neighbor derivative. Existing provenance preserved. Grid is a labeled montage of the 21 crop derivatives.
personallyViewed: four individual questioned footer derivatives: L1 paper/85 (6), L1 monochrome/180 (8), L2 paper/85 (12), L0 monochrome/180 (3)
footerReviewHelpers.result: Correct bound revisions in all 21 footer crops. Initial difficulty reading tiny digits is resolved and is not a screenshot mismatch or failed capture.
